items.headline: Abu Dhabi Property Values Jump 76 Percent to AED 171.26 Billion
items.summary: Total real estate transaction values in Abu Dhabi rose by 76.1 percent to reach AED 171.26 billion. The figures underscore rising investor interest in the emirate.
items.why: It reports official transaction value growth figures for Abu Dhabi.
items.impact_reason: Demonstrates significant capital growth in the emirate.

bullets: On Thursday 5 November, Dubai recorded 485 sales worth AED 1.2bn, which is 0.1% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 65.4% of Thursday's sales, compared to 54.2% over the last seven days.
The median price was AED 1,686 per sq ft, up 0.8% from the 30-day average and down 5.4% from last year.
Over the past seven days, the busiest areas for sales were JVC with 220 sales, Dubai South (DWC) with 208 sales, and Liwan1 with 184 sales.
In October, new rental contracts for a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median price of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Abu Dhabi property transactions surged to AED 171.26 billion, showing a massive increase in property transaction values and sales volume.
Abu Dhabi property values jumped 76 percent to AED 171.26 billion, according to official transaction value growth figures.
Dubai logged 44,841 rental contracts in October, reflecting strong rental market demand.
